overview_description.description: TENDERD is an AI platform for enhancing efficient and sustainable fleet operations. It utilizes AI and analytics to transform equipment data into actionable insights, empowering decision-making. Comprising a suite of modules, TENDERD addresses diverse operational aspects. It enables companies to monitor operations, track progress, and make informed choices resulting in optimized equipment use, reduced carbon footprint, and proactive safety measures. This leads to safer, more efficient, and environmentally conscious operations.

product.name: AI platform
product.description: A platform that uses AI to transform equipment data into insights for reducing costs, increasing utilization, and lowering emissions.

product.name: Fleet utilization optimization
product.description: Uses equipment data to enhance fleet utilization, manage fuel consumption, and schedule maintenance.

product.name: Emissions reduction
product.description: Employs AI to quantify carbon emissions towards achieving a net zero goal.

product.name: Route management
product.description: Enables planning of preferred routes, visualization of trip logs, and monitoring of deliveries.

product.name: Equipment rental marketplace
product.description: Facilitates meeting rental equipment needs and allows revenue generation by renting out idle equipment.

product.name: Industry applications
product.description: Offers solutions tailored to energy, logistics, marine, and construction sectors for operational efficiency and cost reduction.
